data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 integrates SRC_003's arbitrariness claim by adding temporal ordering as the operative variable: the 3-of-26 result is an artifact of mutation proposal order and guard installation order in one repository, which is the specific temporal mechanism behind SRC_003's one-author, one-week confound. Refuted if a formal policy mandated guard-before-mutation ordering and compile.py still showed 1/9, or if the same distribution replicated with a different author following a different order.
